body:
Self-contained specification for Orchestrator frontier builder routing, per-slug builder-fault circuit breaker, and v1.3.0 documentation (ZERO edits to frozen `lib/pools.mjs`; predecessor tickets `T1`–`T4` have already landed `--disable-slash-commands`, `RECOMMENDED_AGY_VERSION = '1.5.9'`, `checkAgyBinary().version`, `plan.disableOrchestrator`, `build.rateLimited`/`model_unavailable`, and the 60-tool `PreToolUse` updates on base):

1. `lib/models.mjs`:
   - Update `TIER_CANDIDATES.frontier` to:
     `Object.freeze(['gemini-pro-orchestrator', 'claude-sonnet-5-5-high', 'gemini-pro-orchestrator-argon', 'gemini-4-argon-high', 'gemini-4-carbon-high', 'claude-opus-5-5-high'])`.
   - Export `FRONTIER_NO_ORCHESTRATOR = Object.freeze(['gemini-4-argon-high', 'claude-sonnet-5-5-high', 'gemini-4-carbon-high', 'claude-opus-5-5-high'])`.
   - Keep Orchestrator slugs strictly excluded from `TIER_CANDIDATES.cheap`, `TIER_CANDIDATES.mid`, `PROSECUTORS`, `PROSECUTOR_CANDIDATES`, and `ROLE_MODELS` (note: `MODELS` on base already defines `'gemini-pro-orchestrator'`, `'gemini-pro-orchestrator-argon'`, and `'gpt-oss-120b-medium'` as `PROSECUTORS.gemini`). Ensure `poolOf()` prefix fallback maps `'hydrogen-*'` / `'gemini-4-hydrogen-*'` to `'gemini-pro'`.
   - Export `setOrchestratorRoutingState({ disableOrchestrator = false, disabledModels = null } = {})` and `resetOrchestratorRoutingState()`. Normalize `disabledModels` inside BOTH `setOrchestratorRoutingState` and `tierCandidates(tier = 'mid', poolHint, options)` using a helper `toModelSet(v)` (`v instanceof Set ? v : (Array.isArray(v) ? new Set(v) : null)`) so callers may pass a `Set`, an `Array` (such as deserialized JSON from `.booster/run.json`), or `null`/`undefined` without throwing! In `tierCandidates(tier = 'mid', poolHint, options)`:
     - `disableOrchestrator = Boolean(options?.disableOrchestrator ?? runtimeState.disableOrchestrator) || process.env.AGB_DISABLE_ORCHESTRATOR === '1'`
     - `disabledSet = toModelSet(options?.disabledModels ?? runtimeState.disabledModels)`
     - Base list for `tier === 'frontier'` is `disableOrchestrator ? FRONTIER_NO_ORCHESTRATOR : TIER_CANDIDATES.frontier`, filtered by `poolHint` and `!(disabledSet && disabledSet.has(m))`. Because `PoolSet.prototype.route(tier, poolHint)` in frozen `lib/pools.mjs` calls `tierCandidates(tier, poolHint)`, setting run-scoped state via `setOrchestratorRoutingState` makes `pools.route('frontier', ...)` honor `AGB_DISABLE_ORCHESTRATOR=1`, `plan.disableOrchestrator`, `< 1.5.9` auto-demotion, and `disabledModels` with zero edits to `lib/pools.mjs`!

2. `lib/status.mjs` & `lib/scheduler.mjs`:
   - In `RunStatus` (`lib/status.mjs`), add `statsContext: null`, `modelStats: {}`, and `disabledModels: []` (serialized as a sorted `string[]` in JSON) to `this.state`, plus `initModelStats(statsContext, priorState)` (restoring `modelStats` and returning a `new Set(priorState.disabledModels)` from a prior `.booster/run.json` **only if** `priorState?.statsContext?.planHash === statsContext.planHash && priorState?.statsContext?.agyVersion === statsContext.agyVersion`, else resetting cleanly to `{}` and returning `new Set()`) and `updateModelStats(modelSlug, { resolved = false, builderFault = false, merged = false, rateLimited = false, disabledModels } = {})` (serializing `[...(disabledModels ?? [])].sort()` to `this.state.disabledModels` and flushing atomically via `this.flush()`).
   - In `lib/scheduler.mjs`, import `{ lt as semverLt } from './semver.mjs'` (existing module in `lib/semver.mjs`) and `createHash` from `'node:crypto'`:
     1. Run `checkAgyBinary({ env: process.env })` before routing; compute `agyVersion = agyCheck.version ?? null` and deterministic `planHash` via `createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify([...tickets].sort((a, b) => a.id.localeCompare(b.id)).map((t) => ({ id: t.id, scope: [...(t.scope ?? [])].sort(), edges: [...(t.edges ?? [])].map((e) => e.to).sort() })))).digest('hex')`.
     2. Set `disableOrchestrator = Boolean(plan.disableOrchestrator) || process.env.AGB_DISABLE_ORCHESTRATOR === '1' || Boolean(agyVersion && semverLt(agyVersion, '1.5.9'))`; when `agyVersion && semverLt(agyVersion, '1.5.9')`, log `[agb] notice: agy ${agyVersion} < 1.5.9; Orchestrator slugs auto-disabled`.
     3. Read prior `.booster/run.json` (if present before `new RunStatus`) into `const disabledModels = status.initModelStats({ planHash, agyVersion }, priorRunJson)` (`disabledModels` is a `Set`) and call `setOrchestratorRoutingState({ disableOrchestrator, disabledModels })` (calling `resetOrchestratorRoutingState()` in `runPlan`'s `finally`). Ensure initial ticket routing (`pools.route`) runs AFTER `setOrchestratorRoutingState`, and whenever `disabledModels` mutates, call `setOrchestratorRoutingState({ disableOrchestrator, disabledModels })`.
     4. Implement **per-ticket, per-slug, builder-fault-only accounting**:
        - Per `modelSlug` schema: `{ resolvedTickets: number, builderFaultTickets: number, mergedTickets: number, rateLimits: number }`.
        - `model_unavailable` -> add `modelSlug` immediately to `disabledModels` (`0` strikes, `0` `resolvedTickets` increment).
        - `build.rateLimited === true` -> increment `rateLimits += 1` only.
        - Ticket merges on `modelSlug` -> `resolvedTickets += 1`, `mergedTickets += 1`.
        - Builder execution fault (`!build.ok` with non-rate-limit, non-`model_unavailable` `kind`, OR `empty_diff` anti-no-op, counted **at most once per `(ticketId, modelSlug)` pair**) -> `resolvedTickets += 1`, `builderFaultTickets += 1`.
        - Gate/test failure (`!gates.ok`) or prosecutor rejection (`verdict === 'block'`) when ticket finishes on `modelSlug` without a builder execution fault -> `resolvedTickets += 1` ONLY (`builderFaultTickets` NOT incremented!).
        - **Per-slug breaker:** when `(modelSlug === 'gemini-pro-orchestrator' || modelSlug === 'gemini-pro-orchestrator-argon') && stats.resolvedTickets >= 4 && stats.builderFaultTickets / stats.resolvedTickets >= 0.5`, log `[agb] warning: demoting ${modelSlug} ...` and add **only that `modelSlug`** to `disabledModels`!

3. Tests & Docs:
   - Update `test/models-live-catalog.test.mjs`, `test/models-registry.test.mjs`, and `test/pools.test.mjs` for the updated `TIER_CANDIDATES.frontier` (`frontier+gemini` = `4`, `cheap`/`mid`/`PROSECUTORS`/`PROSECUTOR_CANDIDATES`/`ROLE_MODELS` exclude `orchestrator`).
   - Create `test/orchestrator-routing.test.mjs` verifying:
     (a) `PoolSet.route('frontier', 'auto')` (imported read-only from `../lib/pools.mjs`): 8 reservations at `{ 'gemini-pro': 4, claude: 4 }` -> 4 `gemini-pro-orchestrator` + 4 `claude-sonnet-5-5-high`; 6 at `{ 'gemini-pro': 2, claude: 4 }` -> 2 + 4; with `AGB_DISABLE_ORCHESTRATOR=1`, `plan.disableOrchestrator: true`, or `agy 1.5.8` / `1.5.9-rc.1` -> 4 `gemini-4-argon-high` + 4 `claude-sonnet-5-5-high`; plus passing both `Set` and `Array` `disabledModels` into `tierCandidates` / `setOrchestratorRoutingState`.
     (b) Per-slug breaker: 4 tickets failing `npm test` gates on `gemini-pro-orchestrator` yield `builderFaultTickets === 0` (no demotion); 4 distinct tickets where 2 hit builder `timeout`/`empty_diff` on `gemini-pro-orchestrator` demote **only** `gemini-pro-orchestrator` while `gemini-pro-orchestrator-argon` remains routable; changing `agyVersion` or `planHash` on resume resets `modelStats`.
     (c) Deterministic 4-Claude Promise-barrier prosecutor FIFO test using existing `PoolSet` (`../lib/pools.mjs`, where `familyCap('claude_gpt')` is already `4` across `'claude'` + `'gpt-oss'`): acquire 4 `'claude-sonnet-5-5-high'` leases to saturate `claude_gpt`, enqueue a 5th `pools.acquire('gpt-oss-120b-medium')` waiter, release 1 `'claude-sonnet-5-5-high'` lease, and assert the `'gpt-oss-120b-medium'` waiter resolves immediately (`0` deadlocks); also assert `poolOf('hydrogen-custom') === 'gemini-pro'`.
     (d) Read-only 60-tool completeness check importing `{ evaluatePayload }` read-only from `'../hooks/policy/evaluate.mjs'` (do NOT edit `hooks/policy/evaluate.mjs` or `test/fixtures/agy-1.5.9-init-tools.json`): for every `name` in `JSON.parse(readFileSync('test/fixtures/agy-1.5.9-init-tools.json', 'utf8')).tools`, invoke `evaluatePayload({ toolCall: { name, args: {} }, workspacePaths: [tmpRepo] }, { env: { AGB_WORKER_MODE: 'readonly' }, home: tmpHome })` and `{ env: { AGB_WORKER_TICKET: 't-1' }, home: tmpHome }`, asserting zero uncaught exceptions and `verdict.decision === 'pass' || verdict.decision === 'deny'` (never `'ask'`).
   - Update `test/live/hooks.live.test.mjs` (`skip` unless `AGB_LIVE_AGY=1`) to read `test/fixtures/agy-1.5.9-init-tools.json` read-only, compare against live `init.tools`, and run a live `gemini-pro-orchestrator` smoke turn.
   - Update `USAGE.md`, `docs/guidelines.md`, and `CHANGELOG.md` to document the v1.3.0 wave features (Orchestrator frontier routing, `AGB_DISABLE_ORCHESTRATOR=1`, `plan.disableOrchestrator`, and the `RECOMMENDED_AGY_VERSION = '1.5.9'` / `--disable-slash-commands` / `sed_file` PreToolUse capabilities landed in `T1`–`T4`).
   - Run `npm run build && node website/scripts/gen-reference.mjs && npm test && npm run coverage:check && npm run plugin:validate`.
title: Enable flag-, version-, and per-slug breaker-guarded Orchestrator frontier routing
